# gns3_project (Resource)

A GNS3 project. Created opened; destroy closes it and then deletes it from disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gns3_project" "lab" {
  name      = "tf-example-project"
  grid_size = 75
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name. Must be unique on the server.

### Optional

- `auto_close` (Boolean) Close the project when the last client disconnects from its notification feed. Default `true`.
- `auto_open` (Boolean) Open the project when the GNS3 server starts. Default `false`.
- `auto_start` (Boolean) Start all nodes when the project is opened. Default `false`.
- `grid_size` (Number) Grid size for nodes on the drawing area. Default `75`.
- `path` (String) Project directory on the server. The server picks one under its projects directory when unset. Changing it replaces the project.
- `scene_height` (Number) Height of the drawing area. Default `1000`.
- `scene_width` (Number) Width of the drawing area. Default `2000`.
- `show_grid` (Boolean) Show the grid on the drawing area. Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String) Project file name (`<name>.gns3`).
- `project_id` (String) Project UUID assigned by the server.
- `status` (String) `opened` or `closed`, as last read from the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by project UUID.
terraform import gns3_project.lab 2d37e1d1-0bbd-4525-8777-529b1bba7f85
```
